</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i>Predecessor<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s Senior Notes Due <em data-td-fact-id="29306661" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2022</em></font></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">In <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> March</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 2012, </em>the Predecessor issued <em data-td-fact-id="29306662" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$500.0</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million aggregate principal amount of <em data-td-fact-id="29306663" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">6.375%</em> senior notes due <em data-td-fact-id="29306664" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2022,</em> or the Senior Notes. In <em data-td-fact-id="29306665" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29306666" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> the Predecessor repurchased in the open market <em data-td-fact-id="29306667" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$70.4</em> million face value of the Senior Notes, recording gains on extinguishment of debt totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29306668" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$35.9</em> million in <em data-td-fact-id="29306669" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016,</em> leaving <em data-td-fact-id="29306670" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$429.6</em> million aggregate principal amount of the Senior Notes outstanding at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016. </em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:7.2pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">In conjunction with the Senior Notes offering, the Predecessor incurred a total of <em data-td-fact-id="29306671" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$12.7</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million in debt issuance costs, of which <em data-td-fact-id="29306672" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.9</em> million remained unamortized at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016. </em>The Predecessor also sold the Senior Notes at a premium, of which <em data-td-fact-id="29306673" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.4</em> million remained unamortized at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016. </em>In the <em data-td-fact-id="29306674" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="29306675" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> based on negotiations that were underway with holders of the Predecessor&rsquo;s Senior Notes, it became evident that the restructuring of our capital structure would <em data-td-fact-id="29306676" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> include a restructuring of the Senior Notes, and that the Senior Notes, as demand obligations, would <em data-td-fact-id="29306677" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be repaid under the terms of the Senior Note indentures in the ordinary course of business. As a result, the Predecessor accelerated the amortization of the debt premium and debt issuance costs, recording additional interest expense of <em data-td-fact-id="29306678" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.3</em> million in the <em data-td-fact-id="29306679" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="29306680" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:7.2pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">In accordance with the Plan and the RSA (see Note <em data-td-fact-id="29306681" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2</em> for detailed discussion of the bankruptcy and emergence), upon emergence from bankruptcy each holder of the Predecessor&rsquo;s Senior Notes received (subject to Jones Act limitations described herein) in exchange for its Senior Notes and accrued interest, its pro rata share of <em data-td-fact-id="29306682" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35.65%</em> of the Successor Equity. The Jones Act, which applies to companies that engage in coastwise trade, requires that, among other things, with respect to a publicly traded company, the aggregate ownership of common stock by non-U.S. citizens be <em data-td-fact-id="29306683" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> more than <em data-td-fact-id="29306684" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">25%</em> of its outstanding common stock. On the Effective Date, certain Noteholders who were eligible to receive common stock of the Successor pursuant to the Plan or the Rights Offering but who are non-U.S. holders received Noteholder Warrants to acquire common stock of the Successor at an exercise price of <em data-td-fact-id="29306685" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$.01</em> per share. In total, the Successor issued <em data-td-fact-id="29306686" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2,267,408</em> shares of its common stock and <em data-td-fact-id="29306687" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1,297,590</em> Noteholder Warrants to the Predecessor&rsquo;s former Noteholders in exchange for <em data-td-fact-id="29306688" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">100%</em> of the outstanding Senior Notes and accrued interest. The Predecessor recorded a <em data-td-fact-id="29306689" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$343.0</em> million gain on settlement of liabilities subject to compromise as a result of the exchange. </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i>&nbsp;</i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i>Predecessor<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s Multicurrency Facility Agreement</font></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">The Predecessor was party to a senior secured, revolving multicurrency credit facility, or the<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;Multicurrency Facility Agreement, among GulfMark Offshore, Inc., as guarantor, <em data-td-fact-id="29306690" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> of the Predecessor&rsquo;s indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, GulfMark Americas, Inc., as the Borrower, a group of financial institutions as the lenders and the Royal Bank of Scotland plc, as agent for the lenders, and the other parties thereto. The Multicurrency Facility Agreement had a scheduled maturity date of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September 26, 2019 </em>and, as amended, committed the lenders to provide revolving loans of up to <em data-td-fact-id="29306691" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$100.0</em> million at any <em data-td-fact-id="29306692" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> time outstanding, subject to certain terms and conditions set forth in the Multicurrency Facility Agreement, and contained a sublimit of <em data-td-fact-id="29306693" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$25.0</em> million for swingline loans and a sublimit of <em data-td-fact-id="29306694" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$5.0</em> million for the issuance of letters of credit. The Multicurrency Facility Agreement was secured by <em data-td-fact-id="29306695" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">24</em> vessels owned by the Borrower.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:36pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">The Predecessor had unamortized fees paid to the arrangers, the agent and the security trustee totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29306696" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.5</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016, </em>which fees were amortized into interest cost on a straight-line basis over the term of the Multicurrency Facility Agreement. <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">In the <em data-td-fact-id="29306697" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="29306698" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> based on negotiations that were underway with the lenders, it became evident that the restructuring of our capital structure would <em data-td-fact-id="29306699" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> include a restructuring of the Multicurrency Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, and that the Multicurrency Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, as a demand obligation, would <em data-td-fact-id="29306700" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be repaid under the terms of the Multicurrency Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> in the ordinary course of business. As a result, the Predecessor accelerated the amortization of debt issuance costs, recording additional interest expense of <em data-td-fact-id="29306701" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.3</em> million in the <em data-td-fact-id="29306702" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="29306703" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:7.2pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 14, 2017, </em>in conjunction with the emergence from bankruptcy, the Predecessor repaid all amounts outstanding under the </font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Multicurrency Facility Agreement, including accrued interest, and terminated the agreement.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>&nbsp;</b></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i>Predecessor<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s Norwegian Facility Agreement</font></i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">The Predecessor was party to a senior secured revolving credit facility, or the Norwegian Facility Agreement, among GulfMark Offshore, Inc., as guarantor, <em data-td-fact-id="29306704" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> of the Predecessor<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Rederi, as the borrower, which we refer to as the Norwegian Borrower, and DNB Bank ASA, a Norwegian bank, as lead arranger and lender, which we refer to as the Norwegian Lender. The Norwegian Facility Agreement had a scheduled maturity date of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> September&nbsp;</em><em data-td-fact-id="29306705" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">30,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306706" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2019</em> and committed the Norwegian Lender to provide loans of up to an aggregate principal amount of <em data-td-fact-id="29306707" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">600.0</em>&nbsp;million NOK (or approximately <em data-td-fact-id="29306708" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$73.1</em> million using the <em data-td-fact-id="29306709" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> year end rate) at any <em data-td-fact-id="29306710" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em> time outstanding, subject to certain terms and conditions. The Norwegian Facility Agreement was secured by </font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306711" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">seven</em> vessels owned by our subsidiary GulfMark UK Ltd. and by <em data-td-fact-id="29306712" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">five</em> vessels of the Norwegian Borrower.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:72pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">The Predecessor had unamortized fees paid to the arrangers, the agent and the security trustee totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29306713" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.2</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016, </em>which fees were amortized into interest cost on a straight-line basis over the term of the Norwegian Facility Agreement. </font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">In the <em data-td-fact-id="29306714" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="29306715" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> based on negotiations that were underway with the lenders, it became evident that the restructuring of our capital structure would <em data-td-fact-id="29306716" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> include a restructuring of the Norwegian Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, and that the Norwegian Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, as a demand obligation, would <em data-td-fact-id="29306717" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be repaid under the terms of the Norwegian Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> in the ordinary course of business. As a result, the Predecessor accelerated the amortization of debt issuance costs, recording additional interest expense of <em data-td-fact-id="29306718" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.1</em> million in the <em data-td-fact-id="29306719" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">first</em> quarter of <em data-td-fact-id="29306720" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017.</em></font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> May 18, 2017, </em>Rederi, as borrower, the other loan parties party thereto, the lenders and DNB Bank ASA, as arranger and agent, entered into an agreement that amended and restated the Norwegian Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> in order to provide funds to Rederi for purposes of making loans to GulfMark Offshore, Inc., as debtor, under the intercompany debtor-in-possession credit agreement among the debtor, as borrower, Rederi, as lender, and DNB Bank ASA, as issuing bank. Pursuant to the Norwegian Facility Agreement</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> as so amended and restated, the Norwegian Lender agreed to make an additional <em data-td-fact-id="29306721" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$35.0</em> million senior secured term loan facility available to Rederi. To secure such term loan facility, Rederi, a wholly owned subsidiary of GulfMark Norge AS, or the Norwegian Parent, and GulfMark UK Ltd., or the UK Guarantor, a wholly owned subsidiary of GulfMark North Sea Limited, or the UK Parent, agreed to place mortgages in favor of the Norwegian Lender on certain additional, previously unencumbered vessels owned by Rederi and certain of our other subsidiaries. In addition, the UK Parent and the Norwegian Parent pledged their shares in the UK Guarantor and Rederi, respectively, to the Norwegian Lender.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">On <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 14, 2017, </em>in conjunction with the emergence from bankruptcy, the Predecessor repaid all amounts outstanding under the Norwegian Facility Agreement, including amounts borrowed to support such intercompany debtor-in-possession credit agreement, including accrued interest, and terminated the agreement.</font></p>

<div contenteditable="false" docsect="9" id="12873" sectdesc="Note to Financial Statements">&nbsp;</div>

<div data-td-parse-id="1" data-td-statement-type="note" data-td-v2v-id="1522067323484" id="thunderdome-statement-849962">
<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><b>(<em data-td-fact-id="29306722" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">7</em>) INCOME TAXES</b></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Emergence from Bankruptcy and Fresh Start Accounting</i></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">Under the Plan, the Predecessor<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s pre-petition equity, bank related debt and certain other obligations were cancelled and extinguished. Absent an exception, a debtor recognizes cancellation of debt income, or CODI, upon discharge of its outstanding indebtedness for an amount of consideration that is less than its adjusted issue price. In accordance with Section <em data-td-fact-id="29306723" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">108</em> of the Code, the Predecessor excluded the amount of discharged indebtedness from taxable income since the Code provides that a debtor in a bankruptcy case <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>exclude CODI from income but must reduce certain tax attributes by the amount of CODI realized as a result of the consummation of a plan of reorganization. The amount of CODI realized by a taxpayer is the adjusted issue price of any indebtedness discharged less than the sum of (i) the amount of cash paid, (ii) the issue price of any new indebtedness issued, and (iii) the fair market value the of any other consideration, including equity, issued. </font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">CODI from the discharge of indebtedness was <em data-td-fact-id="29306724" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$297.3</em> million. As a result of the CODI and in accordance with rules under the Code, <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">we reduced our gross federal net operating loss, or NOL, carryforwards by <em data-td-fact-id="29306725" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$229.3</em> million. The Predecessor was able to retain <em data-td-fact-id="29306726" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$48.1</em> million of gross federal NOLs, <em data-td-fact-id="29306727" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.3</em> million of alternative minimum tax credit and <em data-td-fact-id="29306728" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4.1</em> million of foreign tax credit carryforwards following the bankruptcy.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">Pursuant to the Plan, on the Effective Date, the existing equity interests of the Predecessor were extinguished. New equity interests were issued to creditors in connection with the terms of the Plan, resulting in an ownership change as defined under Section <em data-td-fact-id="29306729" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">382</em> of the Code. Section <em data-td-fact-id="29306730" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">382</em> generally places a limit on the amount of NOLs and other tax attributes arising before the change that <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be used to offset taxable income generated after the ownership change. The utilization of <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">our remaining attributes will depend on several factors, including its future financial performance and certain tax elections. Specifically, utilization of NOLs will be governed by Section <em data-td-fact-id="29306731" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">382</em>(l)(<em data-td-fact-id="29306732" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">6</em>), which will subject us to an overall annual limitation on its use of NOLs and foreign tax credits. This Section <em data-td-fact-id="29306733" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">382</em> limitation is <em data-td-fact-id="29306734" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> expected at this time to significantly impact our ability to realize these attributes.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">In assessing the realizability of deferred tax assets, management considers whether it is more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="29306735" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> that some portion or all of the deferred tax assets will <em data-td-fact-id="29306736" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be realized. The ultimate realization of deferred tax assets is dependent upon the generation of future taxable income during the periods in which those temporary differences become deductible. Management considers the scheduled reversal of existing deferred tax liabilities, projected future results of operations, and tax planning strategies in making this assessment. Based upon the scheduled reversal of existing deferred tax liabilities relating to the U.S. based Vessels, management has concluded that a partial valuation allowance was appropriate as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017.</em></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">The <em data-td-fact-id="29306737" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Tax Act was enacted on <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 22, 2017. </em>The <em data-td-fact-id="29306738" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Tax Act reduces the U.S. federal corporate tax rate from <em data-td-fact-id="29306739" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35%</em> to <em data-td-fact-id="29306740" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">21%,</em> requires companies to recognize a <em data-td-fact-id="29306741" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time transition income inclusion related to all earnings of certain foreign subsidiaries that were previously deferred from U.S. tax and will also create a new tax regime on certain future foreign sourced earnings. As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we have <em data-td-fact-id="29306742" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> completed our accounting for the tax effects of enactment of the <em data-td-fact-id="29306743" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Tax Act; however, in certain cases, as described below, we have made a reasonable estimate of the effects on our existing deferred tax balances and the <em data-td-fact-id="29306744" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time transition income inclusion. In other cases, we have <em data-td-fact-id="29306745" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> been able to make a reasonable estimate and continue to account for those items based on our existing accounting under FASB ASC <em data-td-fact-id="29306746" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No.</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306747" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">740,</em> &ldquo;Income Taxes,&rdquo; and the provisions of the tax laws that were in effect immediately prior to enactment. For the items for which we were able to determine a reasonable estimate, we recognized a provisional income tax benefit of <em data-td-fact-id="29306748" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$15.2</em> million, which is included as a component of income tax expense from continuing operations. In all cases, we will continue to make and refine our calculations as additional analysis is completed. In addition, our estimates <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>also be affected as we gain a more thorough understanding of the tax law.</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>&nbsp;</i></p>

<div data-thunderdome-xbrl-exclude="1" id="PGBK" style="width: 100%; margin-left: 0pt; margin-right: 0pt">
<div id="PGNUM" style="text-align: center; width: 100%; font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt;">77</div>

<hr style="PAGE-BREAK-AFTER: always; border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: #000000; background-color: #000000">
<div id="PGHDR" style="text-align: left; width: 100%">&nbsp;</div>
</div>

<p style="font-family: 'Times New Roman', Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: left">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Provisional Amounts</i></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Deferred tax assets and liabilities: We remeasured certain deferred tax assets and liabilities based on the rates at which they are expected to reverse in the future, which is generally <em data-td-fact-id="29306749" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">21%.</em> However, we are still analyzing certain aspects of the <em data-td-fact-id="29306750" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Tax Act and refining our calculations, which could potentially affect the measurement of these balances or potentially give rise to new deferred tax amounts. The provisional tax benefit recorded related to the remeasurement of our deferred tax liabilities was <em data-td-fact-id="29306751" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.5</em> million.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Foreign Tax Effects</i><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">The <em data-td-fact-id="29306752" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time transition tax is based on our total post-<em data-td-fact-id="29306753" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1986</em> earnings and profits, or E&amp;P, that we had previously recognized at <em data-td-fact-id="29306754" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">35%,</em> net of future foreign tax credits. The <em data-td-fact-id="29306755" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time transition tax was fully offset by the tax effects of tax carryforwards and thus did <em data-td-fact-id="29306756" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> have a material impact to the income tax provision. We have <em data-td-fact-id="29306757" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> yet completed our calculation of the total post-<em data-td-fact-id="29306758" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1986</em> E&amp;P for these foreign subsidiaries. Further, the transition tax is based in part on the amount of those earnings held in cash and other specified assets. This amount <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>change when we finalize the calculation of post-<em data-td-fact-id="29306759" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">1986</em> foreign E&amp;P previously deferred from U.S. federal taxation and finalize the amounts held in cash or other specified assets. <em data-td-fact-id="29306760" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">No</em> additional income taxes have been provided for any remaining undistributed foreign earnings <em data-td-fact-id="29306761" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> subject to the transition tax, or any additional outside basis difference inherent in these entities, as these amounts continue to be indefinitely reinvested in foreign operations. Determining the amount of unrecognized deferred tax liability related to any remaining undistributed foreign earnings <em data-td-fact-id="29306762" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> subject to the transition tax and additional outside basis difference in these entities (<i>i.e</i>., basis difference in excess of that subject to the <em data-td-fact-id="29306763" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">one</em>-time transition tax) is <em data-td-fact-id="29306764" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> practicable.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;"><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">In addition, we had provided deferred tax liabilities in the past on foreign earnings that were <em data-td-fact-id="29306765" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> indefinitely reinvested. As a result of the <em data-td-fact-id="29306766" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Tax Act, we reversed an estimate of the deferred taxes that are <em data-td-fact-id="29306767" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> longer expected to be needed due to the change to the territorial tax system. The provisional tax benefit recorded related to the reversal of previously recognized deferred tax liabilities relating to existing undistributed earnings was <em data-td-fact-id="29306768" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$15.2</em> million. </font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>&nbsp;</i></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">The majority of our non-U.S. based operations are subject to foreign tax systems that provide significant incentives to qualified shipping activities. Our U.K. and Norway based vessels are taxed under &ldquo;tonnage tax&rdquo; regimes. Our qualified Singapore based vessels are exempt from Singapore taxation through <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306769" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2027</em> with extensions available in certain circumstances beyond <em data-td-fact-id="29306770" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2027.</em> The qualified Singapore vessels are also subject to specific qualification requirements which if <em data-td-fact-id="29306771" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> met could jeopardize our qualified status in Singapore. The tonnage tax regimes provide for a tax based on the net tonnage weight of a qualified vessel. These beneficial foreign tax structures continued to result in our earnings incurring significantly lower taxes than those that would apply under the U.S. statutory tax rates or if we were <em data-td-fact-id="29306772" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> a qualified shipping company in those foreign jurisdictions.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">Should our operational structure change or should the laws that created these shipping tax regimes change, we could be required to provide for taxes at rates much higher than those currently reflected in our financial statements. Additionally, if our pre-tax earnings in higher tax jurisdictions increase, there could be a significant increase in our annual effective tax rate. Any such increase could cause volatility in the comparisons of our effective tax rate from period to period.</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Tax Provision</i></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">Income (loss) before income taxes attributable to domestic and foreign operations was (in thousands):</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:14.4pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;"><i>Deferred Taxes </i></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">Deferred income taxes reflect the impact of temporary differences between the amount of assets and liabilities for financial reporting purposes and such amounts as measured by tax laws and regulations. The components of the net deferred tax assets and liabilities at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306777" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306778" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29306779" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> were as follows:</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">The change in the valuation allowance for the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>from <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016 </em>was a decrease of <em data-td-fact-id="29306780" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4.0</em> million. As of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017, </em>we had NOL carryforwards for income tax purposes totaling <em data-td-fact-id="29306781" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$8.1</em> million in the federal U.S., <em data-td-fact-id="29306782" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$6.2</em> million in Louisiana, <em data-td-fact-id="29306783" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$2.6</em> million in Mexico, <em data-td-fact-id="29306784" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3.0</em> million in Norway, <em data-td-fact-id="29306785" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.2</em> million in the U.K., <em data-td-fact-id="29306786" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.2</em> million in Singapore, and <em data-td-fact-id="29306787" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$8.3</em> million in Brazil that are, subject to certain limitations, available to offset future taxable income. We have deferred tax liability reversals for depreciation for which we expect to partially utilize the U.S. NOLs. The U.S. NOLs will begin to expire beginning in <em data-td-fact-id="29306788" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2027.</em> It is more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="29306789" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> that the Mexico NOLs, Norway NOLs and Brazilian NOLs will <em data-td-fact-id="29306790" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> be utilized and a full valuation allowance has been established for such NOLs. <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Under the <em data-td-fact-id="29306791" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> Tax Act, many of the foreign tax credit utilization rules were changed that required us to reassess the realizability of our foreign tax credit deferred tax asset. After review, it was determined that under the new U.S. foreign tax credit rules we would <em data-td-fact-id="29306792" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> ultimately realize the full benefit associated with our foreign tax credits at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017. </em>Accordingly, we recognized a provisional estimate of a valuation allowance related to our foreign tax credits in the amount of <em data-td-fact-id="29306793" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$4.1</em> million. </font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">Based on future expected taxable losses in Mexico, we do <em data-td-fact-id="29306794" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> anticipate we will benefit from certain deferred tax assets and have recorded a valauation allowance of <em data-td-fact-id="29306795" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.6</em> million against them. The following table provides information about the activity of our deferred tax valuation allowance:</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">Based on a more likely than <em data-td-fact-id="29306796" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not,</em> or greater than <em data-td-fact-id="29306797" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">50%</em> probability, recognition threshold and criteria for measurement of a tax position taken or expected to be taken in a tax return, we evaluate and record in certain circumstances an income tax liability for uncertain income tax positions. Numerous factors contribute to our evaluation and estimation of our tax positions and related tax liabilities and/or benefits, which <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be adjusted periodically and <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>ultimately be resolved differently than we anticipate. We also consider existing accounting guidance on de-recognition, measurement, classification, interest and penalties, accounting in interim periods, disclosure and transition. Accordingly, we continue to recognize income tax related penalties and interest in our provision for income taxes and, to the extent applicable, in the corresponding balance sheet presentations for accrued income tax assets and liabilities, including any amounts for uncertain tax positions included in other income taxes payable in the consolidated balance sheets and which total <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306798" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$21.7</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em></font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306799" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306800" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306801" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$21.1</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em></font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306802" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306803" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29306804" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$24.7</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2015. </em>In addition, the deferred tax asset was reduced by a <em data-td-fact-id="29306805" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3.3</em> million unrecognized tax benefit for an uncertain tax position.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin-bottom:0pt;margin-left:36pt;margin-right:0pt;margin-top:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:14.4pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">We accrue interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits in our provision for income taxes. At <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306806" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306807" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> we had accrued interest and penalties related to unrecognized tax benefits of <em data-td-fact-id="29306808" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$12.5</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million. The amount of interest and penalties recognized in our tax provision for the year ended <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em></font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306809" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306810" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> was <em data-td-fact-id="29306811" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$0.6</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million. The unrecognized tax benefits if recognized would affect the effective tax rate. We do <em data-td-fact-id="29306812" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> expect a significant change to our unrecognized tax benefits in the next <em data-td-fact-id="29306813" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">12</em> months.</font></p>

<p style="background-color:#FFFFFF;font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">We execute letters of credit, performance bonds and other guarantees in the normal course of business that ensure our performance or payments to <em data-td-fact-id="29306830" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">third</em> parties.<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> The aggregate notional value of these instruments as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017 </em>attributable to the Successor was <em data-td-fact-id="29306831" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3.2</em><em> </em>million. The aggregate notional value of these instruments attributable to the Predecessor was <em data-td-fact-id="29306832" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$3.2</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> November 14, 2017, </em><em data-td-fact-id="29306833" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.2</em> million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2016 </em>and <em data-td-fact-id="29306834" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">$1.8</em>&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">million at <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December&nbsp;</em></font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306835" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306836" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> In the past, <em data-td-fact-id="29306837" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> significant claims have been made against these financial instruments. We believe the likelihood of demand for payment under these instruments is remote and expect <em data-td-fact-id="29306838" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> material cash outlays to occur from these instruments.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">We have contingent liabilities and future claims for which we have made estimates of the amount of the eventual cost to liquidate these liabilities or claims. These liabilities and claims <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>involve threatened or actual litigation where damages have <em data-td-fact-id="29306839" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> been specifically quantified but we have made an assessment of our exposure and recorded a provision in our accounts for the expected loss. <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">We intend to defend these matters vigorously; however, litigation is inherently unpredictable, and the ultimate outcome or effect of such lawsuits and actions cannot be predicted with certainty. As a result, there can be <em data-td-fact-id="29306840" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> assurance as to the ultimate outcome of these lawsuits. Any claims against us, whether meritorious or <em data-td-fact-id="29306841" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not,</em> could cause us to incur costs and expenses, require significant amounts of management time and result in the diversion of significant operations resources. Other claims or liabilities, including those related to taxes in foreign jurisdictions, <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>be estimated based on our experience in these matters and, where appropriate, the advice of outside counsel or other outside experts. Upon the ultimate resolution of the uncertainties surrounding our estimates of contingent liabilities and future claims, our future reported financial results will be impacted by the difference, if any, between our estimates and the actual amounts paid to settle the liabilities. In addition to estimates related to litigation and tax liabilities, other examples of liabilities requiring estimates of future exposure include contingencies arising out of acquisitions and divestitures. We determine our contingent liabilities based on the most recent information available to us at the time of such determination regarding the nature of the exposure. Such exposures <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> may </em>change from period to period based upon updated relevant facts and circumstances, which can cause the estimates to change. In the recent past, our estimates for contingent liabilities have been sufficient to cover the actual amount of our exposure. We do <em data-td-fact-id="29306842" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> believe that the outcome of these matters will have a material adverse effect on our business, financial condition, or results of operations.</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;"><i>Stock Options, Restricted Stock and Stock Option Plans </i></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">On the Effective Date, <font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">and in accordance with the Plan, we reserved <em data-td-fact-id="29306844" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">876,553</em> shares of Successor common stock for issuance under a management incentive plan. The Board has <em data-td-fact-id="29306845" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> yet approved a management incentive plan and <em data-td-fact-id="29306846" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">no</em> shares had been granted as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December 31, 2017. </em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">In the Predecessor periods of <em data-td-fact-id="29306847" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306848" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and <em data-td-fact-id="29306849" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015,</em> we had outstanding equity-classified awards in the form of stock options and restricted stock under <em data-td-fact-id="29306850" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> former Equity Incentive Plans<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">, or the Former Equity Plans. All awards under the Former Equity Plans that had <em data-td-fact-id="29306851" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> been forfeited were deemed to vest on a date prior to the Effective Date in connection with the Plan. Predecessor Class A common stock underlying such awards were cancelled on the Effective Date and the holders of such interests received their pro rata share of Successor common stock and Equity Warrants.&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;</font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:18pt;">A summary of the unvested restricted stock awarded pursuant to our Predecessor incentive equity plans as of <em data-td-invalid-detail="1" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;"> December</em><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&nbsp;</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"><em data-td-fact-id="29306852" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">31,</em> <em data-td-fact-id="29306853" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016</em> and changes during <em data-td-fact-id="29306854" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> is presented below: </font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:14.4pt;">&nbsp;</p>

<p style="font-family: &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, serif; font-size: 10pt; margin: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 18pt;">Predecessor stock options granted to purchase our shares had an exercise price equal to, or greater than, the fair market value of the Predecessor<font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;">&rsquo;s Class A common stock on the date of grant. These stock options vested over <em data-td-fact-id="29306855" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> from the date of grant and terminated at the earlier of the date of exercise or <em data-td-fact-id="29306856" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">seven</em> years</font><font style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;"> from the date of grant. The fair value of stock option awards is determined using the Black-Scholes option-pricing model. The expected life of an option is estimated based on historical exercise behavior. Volatility assumptions are estimated based on the average of historical volatility over the previous <em data-td-fact-id="29306857" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">three</em> years measured from the grant date. Risk-free interest rates are based on U.S. Government Zero Coupon Bonds with a maturity corresponding to the Safe Harbor term. The dividend yield is based on the previous <em data-td-fact-id="29306858" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">four</em> quarters to the date of grant divided by the average stock price for the previous <em data-td-fact-id="29306859" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">200</em> days. Expected forfeiture rates are estimated based on historical forfeiture experience. We used the following weighted-average assumptions to estimate the fair value of stock options granted during <em data-td-fact-id="29306860" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2015.</em> The Predecessor did <em data-td-fact-id="29306861" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">not</em> grant any options in <em data-td-fact-id="29306862" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2017</em> or <em data-td-fact-id="29306863" style="font-weight: inherit; font-style: normal;">2016.</em></font></p>

<p style="font-family:'Times New Roman', Times, serif;font-size:10pt;margin:0pt;text-align:justify;text-indent:14.4pt;">&nbsp;</p>
